note: Planning model, not a forecast. Every number below is an assumption you can change; prices and benchmarks carry their source. Running costs come from the service costs model (tools/costs/costs.json, same growth stages).

options.name: Freemium + Ruta Pro subscription
options.pitch: Lessons, drills and reading stay free; Pro unlocks unlimited Profe conversations and grading, full mock exams and offline audio.
options.price: $9.99 a month or $69.99 a year (about 17% under Duolingo Super and 35% under Babbel's yearly plans)
options.who: Self-study learners worldwide; the default channel (Google Play).
options.arppu_note: Assumes 70% choose yearly ($5.83 a month) and 30% monthly ($9.99).
pros: Standard for the category, learners know it
Store handles payments, refunds and tax
cons: Needs many users: conversion is single-digit
Competes head-on with Duolingo and Babbel

options.name: DELE Exam Pass (one-off)
options.pitch: 3 months of everything, built around one exam date: full mock exams with timing, graded writing and speaking, a study plan to the day.
options.price: $29.99 once (well under 25% of the exam fee itself)
options.who: Candidates registered for a DELE session; peaks before the registration deadlines.
pros: Clear promise and deadline, easy to sell
cons: One-off: no recurring income unless they move up a level

options.name: Schools, academies and exam centres (B2B licence)
options.pitch: Seats for language schools, universities and DELE exam centres, with the coverage dashboard as a teacher tool and class progress reports.
options.price: $25 per student per year (minimum 30 seats), invoiced directly
options.who: Instituto Cervantes-accredited centres, academies, universities, companies with Spanish-learning staff (Panama: Canal, logistics, tourism).
pros: The curriculum dashboard is a real differentiator
cons: Needs teacher accounts, invoicing and support

options.name: Regional pricing for Panama and Latin America
options.pitch: The same Pro at a local price, marketed with Casco Viejo content, Panamanian Spanish and partnerships with schools and employers.
options.who: Learners in Panama and the region; expats; tourism and hospitality staff.

conversion.note: Share of monthly active users paying for Pro. Duolingo reached 9.2% after years of tuning; a new app starts lower.

assumptions.people_note: Support, content review and a part-time marketer from launch; not the founders' own time.
